    Conformance¶

    rn_forge.web.conformance ¶

    Framework-independent HTTP conformance scenarios and redaction rules.

    REDACTED = '<redacted>' module-attribute ¶

    What :func:redact substitutes for a member that legitimately varies.

    VARIABLE_MEMBERS = frozenset({'instance', 'traceId', 'timestamp'}) module-attribute ¶

    Body members that differ per request and must not be compared literally.

    instance is the request path plus, in practice, an id the driver chose; traceId is generated per request (or per trace, when a caller's traceparent continues one); timestamp is the clock. Everything else in a response body is part of the contract and is compared exactly.

    ConformanceArea = Literal['problem', 'concurrency', 'pagination', 'idempotency', 'health', 'auth', 'casing', 'tracing', 'deprecation', 'discovery', 'security', 'cors', 'transfer', 'timestamps', 'operations'] ¶

    Areas covered by the conformance suite.

    ConformanceCase(id, area, description, request, expect_status, depends_on=(), expect_headers=dict[str, str](), expect_absent_headers=frozenset(), expect_body=dict[str, Any](), expect_header_patterns=dict[str, str](), expect_text=None) dataclass ¶

    One wire decision, expressed as a request and the response it must get.

    Header names are compared case-insensitively and values exactly. Bodies are compared after :func:redact. depends_on names prerequisite requests in execution order.

    expect_header_patterns = field(default_factory=(dict[str, str])) class-attribute instance-attribute ¶

    Header name → regular expression, matched with re.fullmatch against the header value. Header names are compared case-insensitively, as for :attr:expect_headers. Used where the exact value is not deterministic (a generated span id in traceresponse).

    expect_text = None class-attribute instance-attribute ¶

    The exact response body, for a case whose body is not JSON (a CSV export). When set, :attr:expect_body is not compared.

    RequestSpec(method, path, headers=dict[str, str](), query=dict[str, str](), body=None) dataclass ¶

    The request a driver must issue.

    path is relative to whatever base the driver mounts the fixture app at, and always begins with /.

    case_by_id(case_id) ¶

    Return the case with case_id, for resolving depends_on.

    Raises:

    Type Description
    KeyError

    No case has that id.

    cases_for(area) ¶

    Return every case in area, in table order.

    redact(body) ¶

    Blank the members that legitimately differ per request.

    Recurses into nested mappings and lists, so a problem body's extensions and a page's items are covered too. Idempotent: redacting an already-redacted body returns the same thing, which is what makes it safe for a driver to apply without knowing whether the table's expectation was already redacted.

    rn_forge.web.conformance.cases ¶

    HTTP conformance cases consumed by framework-specific test drivers.

    ORDERED_PAGE_1_NEXT_TOKEN = encode_cursor('2', '2', 'id desc') module-attribute ¶

    The token page one must return.

    Asserted exactly, not redacted. A token is opaque to a client; between two servers running the same codec over the same keyset it is deterministic, and two stacks that emit different tokens for the same page have diverged in a way no client-visible field would show.
